b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Revival complete. Good morning, Engineer Reyes. I apologize for the... circumstances.

c.speaker: kai
c.text: Wh... where is everyone? Why is it so quiet?

d.speaker: halcyon
d.text: The Leviathan is compromised. An organism designated THE BLOOM has spread through every deck. Command staff are unresponsive.

e.speaker: halcyon
e.text: Reactor containment fails in 72 hours. We have drifted off course. At reactor failure we will be unable to avoid the star Thalassa-B.

f.speaker: kai
f.text: And you woke up... me? I fix air filters.

g.speaker: halcyon
g.text: Yours was the only engineering pod still functional. Please reach the Bridge at the top of the ship and restore navigation. Ten thousand colonists are counting on you.

h.speaker: narrator
h.name: How to play
h.text: Use the D-pad or tap a tile to move. Walk into doors, people and objects to interact. Every step, fight and repair burns reactor time, so choose your detours wisely.

i.speaker: halcyon
i.text: The maintenance door south of the corridor requires a drone override. A maintenance drone was last logged in the storage closet, east of this bay.

a.speaker: kai
a.text: The maintenance door is south of here. HALCYON said there's a drone in the storage closet to the east. The one with the lights out. Great.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Through the observation window the stars wheel slowly. One of them is brighter than the rest. Bigger. Getting bigger.

b.speaker: kai
b.text: So that's Thalassa-B. Seventy-two hours until we're inside it.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Pretty, though. In a 'we are all going to be vaporized' kind of way.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Wedged between two crates, a battered maintenance drone sparks weakly. One lens flickers.

b.speaker: bolt
b.name: Drone
b.text: ...Hello? Is someone there? It's very dark in here. I don't like the dark. Please tell me you're not a spore monster.

choices.text: I might be a spore monster.

c.speaker: bolt
c.name: Drone
c.text: That's not funny. That is the opposite of funny.

d.speaker: narrator
d.text: Kai pries open the drone's chassis. A cracked capacitor, a jammed rotor, and... is that a sandwich?

e.speaker: kai
e.text: Okay. Wrench here, jumper there, and... hit it.

f.speaker: bolt
f.text: SYSTEMS ONLINE! Oh wow, I can see! You have a face! Faces are great.

g.speaker: bolt
g.text: Unit B-0LT-7, maintenance and logistics. You can call me BOLT. Everyone does. Did. Where is everyone?

h.speaker: kai
h.text: I was hoping you could tell me. I'm Kai. Apparently I'm the only one awake.

i.speaker: bolt
i.text: My memory files are scrambled. I remember carrying something. Something warm. Then nothing. Then this closet.

j.speaker: bolt
j.text: I can open maintenance locks, scan for hidden things, and zap bad guys. I can also light up dark places. Please let me light up dark places.

k.speaker: narrator
k.name: BOLT joined
k.text: BOLT follows you, lights dark rooms, and hacks maintenance doors. Tap SCAN to reveal hidden items nearby. It costs a few minutes.

l.speaker: bolt
l.text: Wait. One of my files just decrypted itself. That's weird. Want to see?

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: It's dark in here. Really dark. I'm lighting it up, but I want it on the record: I hate this.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Also, something is moving down there. Organic. Squishy. Gross.

c.speaker: narrator
c.name: Battle tip
c.text: In battle, Kai acts first, then BOLT. BOLT's Zap deals EMP damage and can stun. Scan reveals weaknesses. Hitting a weakness deals 50% more damage.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: Big energy signature ahead. Coolant tanks, heavy servos... it's the Warden, the cryo deck's maintenance robot. It used to fix pods.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: If you want to heal up at the med bay or save the game, now would be the time. I'm not scared. You're scared.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Cryo-Warden unfolds from its alcove: three meters of steel and frost. Bloom tendrils pulse through its joints.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.name: Warden Unit
b.text: PROTOCOL: PRESERVE. PRESERVE. PRESERVE THE GARDEN.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: It thinks the Bloom is part of the pods! Kai, EMP scrambles it, so let me Zap it.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: When its tanks glow white, it's charging a coolant surge. That's when I throw up a Shield!

e.speaker: bolt
e.text: When its tanks glow white, it's charging a coolant surge. Brace yourself when that happens!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Warden sags, frost hissing from its seams. Its optic flickers once and goes dark.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Sorry, big guy. You were just doing your job. Badly, at the end. But still.

c.speaker: kai
c.text: The lift controls are through that door. Let's get the relay running.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The lift power relay is dead. Burned couplings, a fried regulator, and frost in everything.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Ooh, the lift is humming! That's the sound of progress. Or a malfunction. Mostly progress.

done.speaker: narrator
done.text: The relay hums steadily. The lift has power.

off.speaker: narrator
off.text: The lift is dead. Its panel reads: RELAY FAULT. NO POWER.

a.speaker: halcyon
a.text: Lift to Hydroponics ready. Warning: the descent systems are damaged. This lift only travels up. You will not be able to return.

again.speaker: narrator
again.text: Pod C-117 hums quietly. REYES, MIA. STATUS: STABLE.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Pod C-117. Frost has crept across the glass, but the readout glows green. REYES, MIA. STATUS: STABLE.

d.speaker: kai
d.text: My little sister. She talked me into this whole colony thing. 'A real sky, Kai. Think about it.'

e.speaker: bolt
e.text: Then let's make sure she gets one. A sky, I mean. Not the star. The star would be bad.

f.speaker: kai
f.text: Hang on, Mia. I'm going to fix this.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: A Shield Emitter! Install it, install it, install it! ...Ahh. Now I can protect YOU.

b.speaker: narrator
b.name: New ability
b.text: BOLT learned SHIELD: a barrier around Kai that absorbs damage for 2 turns. Perfect for telegraphed attacks.
